recipes.emptyBody: Your recipes will be here: what goes into each product and base, and how much one batch makes. Add one on a base's or a product's page.

section.title: Recipe
section.bundleHint: A bundle sells other products together, such as a gift box, in place of a recipe.

card.removeBody: Its lines go with it. Production runs made from it keep what they used.
card.notWeighed: Not measured by weight, so it has no share.

dialog.batchQuantityHint: In the unit it's counted in.
dialog.notesHint: How it's made, shown above its lines.
dialog.byRatioHint: Give each ingredient's parts and the batch's ingredients total, in place of each amount.
dialog.totalHint: What the parts add up to: lines measured differently, such as a flavoring in mL, scale along.
dialog.makesHint: In the unit it's counted in; lower it for what's lost in making.
dialog.previewFailed: Hoard couldn't work this recipe out yet.

errors.RECIPE_LINE_KIND: A recipe holds materials that keep stock and bases; a bundle holds products.
errors.RECIPE_CYCLE: That would make it from itself.
errors.RECIPE_BUNDLE: A bundle's products take no recipe of their own.
errors.RECIPE_RATIO_TOTAL: The ingredients total adds up the lines measured like it, and none is: give it a unit one of them is in.
